title: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte
summary: Bookmark this page for Rappler's comprehensive coverage of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial at the Senate

blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte — the first Philippine public official to be impeached twice by the House of Representatives — began at 2 pm on Monday, July 6.

There are four articles of impeachment against Duterte involving alleged misuse of confidential funds, unexplained wealth, bribery of Department of Education officials, and grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family.

Only 21 out of 24 senator-judges are physically present. Senator Bato dela Rosa remains in hiding as he faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, Senator Jinggoy Estrada has been detained and suspended in connection with a plunder case, and Senator Rodante Marcoleta surrendered to authorities as he also faces a plunder case.
On this page, we bring you the latest updates, analyses, videos, and photos as the trial of the Vice President unfolds.

Were prosecutors even on the same page when Trillanes was dropped as witness?

blocks.text: 17 hours ago
‘Hesitancy of senators considered in withdrawal of Trillanes’ testimony’ — Kapunan

Private prosecutor Lorna Kapunan says the “hesitancy of the senators” was considered in the decision to withdraw former senator Antonio “Sonny” Trillanes IV as a witness, citing Presiding Officer Chiz Escudero’s manifestation on whether it was necessary to present ex-lawmaker.

blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

blocks.text: Tolosa: Trillanes withdrawal won’t derail wealth case

Prosecution spokesperson Jay Tolosa says former senator Antonio Trillanes IV’s decision to withdraw as a witness will not affect the prosecution’s unexplained wealth case against Vice President Sara Duterte.
In an interview with Rappler, Tolosa says the prosecution will present other witnesses and documents, including testimony from AMLC and bank representatives, to establish its allegations.

blocks.text: Impeachment court grants defense’s request to defer AMLC witness testimony

The Senate impeachment court grants the defense’s request to defer the testimony of AMLC Director Ronel Buenaventura scheduled for October 1, providing them more time to study AMLC documents and examine the witness.
The trial will resume on Monday, October 5.

blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

blocks.text: Hontiveros: No absolute AMLC confidentiality rule binds court

Senator-judge Risa Hontiveros puts on the record that no absolute confidentiality requirement for Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) officials binds an impeachment court, during the 31st day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial.

blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

blocks.text: Sotto expresses ‘strong reservations’ on trial delay

Senator-judge Vicente Sotto III expresses “strong reservations” about postponing the October 1 impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, amid the defense’s request for more time to study Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) documents and examine AMLC Director Ronel Buenaventura. Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano says he shares Sotto’s reservations but nonetheless urges the impeachment court to grant the defense’s request.

blocks.text: 20 hours ago
Properties are in Sara Duterte’s SALN, asserts defense lawyer

Defense lawyer Lindon Bacquel says it is their position that the properties presented by two witnesses were declared in Vice President Sara Duterte’s Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth, during the 31st day of Duterte’s impeachment trial on Thursday, October 1.

blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

blocks.text: Baldonado says she’s unaware of Sara Duterte’s SALN
Davao City Register of Deeds IV Kathy Florence Baldonado says she has no personal knowledge of Vice President Sara Duterte’s properties, liabilities, net worth, or business interests.
She says she cannot testify on whether Duterte’s SALN is complete or incomplete.
